structuredContent.text: A comment author may edit their own comment for 30 minutes after the comment was created. After that, the API refuses the edit.

content.text: The rule source says 30 minutes, but the code uses 15. Before changing anything, I'll check the spec and the source text behind the answer.

Endpoint: PUT /api/articles/:slug/comments/:id, body {"comment":{"body":"..."}}. Only the author changes the text of their own comment.
